channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Government working to bring home Maltese citizens from the Middle East
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela says his office and the deputy prime minister are working to bring home Maltese and Gozitan citizens stranded in the Middle East

item.title: Alex Borg lambasts prime minister for rushing anti-deadlock mechanism without consulting Opposition
item.description: Nationalist Party leader Alex Borg says Prime Minister Robert Abela cannot table anti-deadlock legislation without opposition discussion, warning that any such mechanism still requires a two-thirds majority in parliament.

item.title: ADPD calls Vision 2050 a superficial spectacle that fails to address fundamental challenges
item.description: ADPD-The Green Party says government's long-term plan ignores ecology, social welfare and climate change

item.title: Iran kills eight in Israel, strikes UAE as attacks continue
item.description: Iran's latest missile attacks have left at least eight people dead in Israel and three more killed in the UAE, with dozens injured across both countries as authorities warn the situation remains ongoing.

item.title: Ian Borg condemns Iran’s retaliation on countries not involved in the attacks
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ian Borg contacts Qatar and UAE officials as Malta monitors situation for Maltese nationals in the region

item.title: A total of 1,619 Maltese nationals across Middle East as conflict escalates
item.description: At least 134 Maltese and Gozitan citizens seek consular assistance across seven countries following US-Israel strikes on Iran

item.title: BirdLife Malta condemns government move to reopen finch trapping licences
item.description: BirdLife Malta calls decision a pre-election manoeuvre that puts Malta in breach of EU law and leaves the countryside open to further damage

item.title: EU unlocks funding for safe abortion travel but it’s a long road for Maltese women
item.description: The European Commission says existing EU funds can support access to safe abortion care, including travel abroad, but with abortion illegal in Malta, any benefit for Maltese women will depend on other countries or NGOs stepping in

item.title: Swieqi football club left fuming after promised land is given to Valletta FC instead
item.description: Swieqi United Football Club officials were left fuming at government plans to grant land in Pembroke to Valletta FC for new sports facilities

item.title: Deciphering a tragicomedy
item.description: It was a mistake for Robert Abela to meet him. And it is a mistake for the Prime Minister to believe that a meeting can solve everything. It was bigger mistake that Wenzu Mintoff wrote a letter revealing all to third parties
